title: AI Paste Guard
description: Stops hidden prompt injections riding in on a paste: it reads the HTML clipboard data pasted into an AI prompt box, holds the paste when it carries text the person couldn't see (white or same-colour text, zero-size or transparent text, display:none, off-screen and clipped elements, HTML comments, alt or title text with instructions, Unicode tag-character payloads decoded back to ASCII) while ignoring the clipboard's own StartFragment and Word markers, framework comments (WordPress, React, Vue, Angular), gradient text, screen-reader-only labels and light text copied from dark-mode pages (inferred when most of the paste is light, so white-on-white injections still show), shows each passage with injection phrasing marked and whether it would reach a plain-text box, and pastes only the visible text in one tap with an undo.
stops: Hidden prompt injection in a paste
